items.excerpt: Liverpool played out a 0-0 draw with Barclays Women’s Super League leaders Chelsea on Saturday. Both sides carved out chances across the course of the clash at St Helens Stadium, with Khiara Keating outstanding in the Reds’ goal. Neither landed a mark on the scoresheet, though, and Gareth Taylor’s team made it four games unbeaten in all competitions. There was a liveliness from both sides without much in the way of major chances during the opening 20 minutes. Ellie Carpenter had the best sight of goal for the visitors as she raced free down the right and was able to move into the penalty area.
